column4: Methodology

Item IDs were matched against SimulationCraft’s current Midnight item database. Displayed stats and scaled item effects were then captured from Wowhead at each Season 2 item level. Values preserve Wowhead’s in-game display rounding. Overlapping Hero/Myth item levels intentionally repeat the same values.

Sources:
https://github.com/simulationcraft/simc
https://www.wowhead.com/guide/midnight/item-level-gear-upgrades-dawncrests
Individual Wowhead item links are included on each data sheet.
